heading: Κεφ. ιγ΄. — CHAP. XIII.
paragraphs:
Prophets and teachers are here spoken of as resident ministers,
entitled to maintenance. They were to have the first-fruits of
everything. Σιτία, in Classic Greek, is the plural of
σιτίον, meaning “food” in general. Here, as in the Byzantine
Greek, it is a singular noun, and means “batch,” or “baking
of bread.”
